ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logistical coordinator that groups elderly residents in New Brunswick for community outings, automatically matching them with student volunteer drivers from Rutgers University.
ideas.title: New Brunswick Senior Mobility Link
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a concrete social impact problem relevant to the local New Brunswick community, following the winning pattern of high-value social good applications like Outreach.

ideas.pitch: A localized AI patient acquisition and trust platform designed for student-run dental clinics or local health initiatives to convert inquiries into booked appointments securely.
ideas.title: Campus Prosthodontic Patient Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a niche healthcare trust and conversion problem with immediate utility, mirroring the winning formula of the Global-Smile patient acquisition engine.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent meal planner that ingests daily dining hall menus across Rutgers campus to deliver hyper-personalized nutritional insights and meal recommendations for students.
ideas.title: Rutgers Dining AI Nutrition & Wellness Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets a pain familiar to students and organizers in the room—campus dining—leveraging the same practical AI-wellness approach that won the Hour Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A predictive risk modeling dashboard using Poisson regression to forecast potential safety incidents or equipment failures in university research laboratories based on historical usage logs.
ideas.title: AI Incident Forecaster for Campus Labs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous quantitative forecasting and statistical modeling (Poisson GAMs) to institutional safety, echoing the winning methodology of the Apart Research AI Forecasting hack.

ideas.pitch: An automated monitoring tool using satellite imagery APIs to detect unauthorized construction or land use changes around university real estate and surrounding municipality zones.
ideas.title: Campus Land Compliance Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies complex geospatial processing and computer vision to real-world industrial and land compliance, following the runner-up success of GeoNex-ATLAS.
